title: Ep 17 — The quietest two days yet from the big three, and the scheduler that hit a hundred and forty five thousand a month once it started selling to robots
description: Anthropic opens a formal vetted-access track for cybersecurity capabilities and Google ships a free Preferred Sources button for AI search visibility, while OpenAI, Cursor, Replit and the voice AI vendors stay unusually quiet. Plus a deep dive on open source scheduler Postiz, which grew from seven hundred dollars a month to over a hundred and forty five thousand by repositioning for AI agents, and a live DCMS consultation on National Lottery good causes funding that speaks directly to PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships.
